prompt: Use Spectrum 1-5: page #19161D, text #F6F3F7, accent #E58AB4, secondary surface #373725, text on accent #111111. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
